name: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Iloilo
short_description: A half marathon with 10 km, 5 km, 3 km team and 1 km dog-run races, run on 20 September 2026 at Atria Park District, Iloilo City, Philippines, and organised by RUNRIO for EastWest Bank.
ai_summary: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Iloilo was run on Sunday 20 September 2026, starting and finishing at Atria Park District in Iloilo City, Philippines. RUNRIO organised it for EastWest Bank as a leg of the four-leg EastWest Dream Run 2026 series. It offered a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km, a 3 km race for groups of four and a 1 km dog run.
pros: Five races, from a 1 km dog run to the 21 km, suit families and first-timers
Unhurried 21 km: a 2:37:39 median and finishers out to 3:40 in 2026
Every finisher gets a medal, towel and loot bag; 21 km finishers a shirt
Full results for every distance, with gun and chip times
Elite winners in 2026: both 21 km champions were Team 7-Eleven qualifiers
cons: No route map, start times or cut-offs on the 2026 race pages
Regular 21 km entry cost P2,000 in 2026
Thin field behind the winners: only nine runners broke 1:40 in the 2026 21 km
No refunds, deferrals or transfers, and no category changes
research_highlights: Distance options are 1K (Dog Run), 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21K, organized by RUNRIO.
Race entitlements reported for the series include a race bib, race singlet, dog bandana, finisher's towel, a 21K finisher's shirt, loot bag, and finisher's medal.
Organiser releases describe partner booths, games and giveaways at the Iloilo leg, and an EastWest Horizons Recovery Lounge with massage and yoga sessions after the finish.
The Manila leg, the first of the 2026 series, drew nearly 7,000 participants, and the Iloilo leg more than 2,000, according to the organiser.
research_watchouts: The Clark leg of the same 2026 series, set for 30 August, was postponed due to prevailing weather conditions, according to EastWest Bank, so dates within the series can change.
Coverage found so far is largely press-release style content from EastWest Bank and syndicated blog posts, with limited independent or critical runner commentary.

faqs.question: When was the EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Iloilo?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Iloilo was run on Sunday 20 September 2026. It started and finished at Atria Park District in Iloilo City, and the organiser described it as the second leg of the four-leg 2026 series. More than 2,000 runners, families and friends took part, according to the organiser.

faqs.question: What distances were offered at the Iloilo leg?
faqs.answer: The Iloilo leg offered five categories: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km, a 3 km race for groups of four, and a 1 km dog run. The half marathon was the main race. Runners in the 21 km had to be 18 or older, and 10 km runners 16 or older.

faqs.question: Who organised the EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Iloilo?
faqs.answer: RUNRIO organised the Iloilo leg for EastWest Bank, the title sponsor of the EastWest Dream Run series, in support of the Department of Tourism's Love the Philippines campaign. RUNRIO's race mechanics set the rules, including placings on gun time and disqualification for starting more than 15 minutes after a category's flag-off.
